title: Model Feature Trajectory Playbook: prioritizing emerging capabilities for enterprise fit
creator: Priya Patel
description: Objective: Create an actionable playbook that translates continuous model-landscape signals into prioritized product bets for enterprise customers. Scope: (1) define signal taxonomy (capability, latency/cost profile, governance fit), (2) specify scoring and decay functions to rank emergent features, (3) provide concrete triage and handoff workflows for PM/Eng/SE to evaluate vendor/model integration effort and business impact, (4) deliver a lightweight dashboard template and a sample weekly watch-report for leadership. Deliverables: playbook doc, scoring spreadsheet, dashboard mock, 6-week pilot plan. Success metrics: time-to-decision for new model signals reduced from 10d to <=3d, top-5 prioritized features with validated enterprise fit score >=8/10, pilot integrations cost/latency delta captured for 3 models.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc with signal taxonomy and step-by-step triage workflow published in Confluence
Scoring spreadsheet (capability x risk x infra cost) checked into Drive with sample inputs
Dashboard mock uploaded and linked to a query template in the Console for weekly monitoring
Pilot plan with 3 candidate model features and assigned engineering owners

decisions: Adopt a 3-week exponential decay window for capability signals (weight 0.5 each week) to reduce noise from short-term spikes.
Score dimensions: capability delta, enterprise alignment, infra delta (latency/cost), security gap. All scored 1-10 then weighted.
Pilot will focus on features with high enterprise alignment >=7 and infra delta <=30% latency increase.
Manual annotation step required for quantization readiness until ENG telemetry provides model-level quant metrics.
tradeoffs_and_risks: Aggressive automation of signal scoring risks false positives from benchmark leaks; mitigated by human-in-the-loop verification for top-10 signals.
Prioritizing enterprise fit may underweight consumer-driven signals that could indicate future enterprise demand; plan to maintain a separate 'long lead' watchlist.
Running a 3-model pilot increases short-term engineering load; will use dedicated SE hours allocated from Solutions Eng budget.
